rationale: Candidate closely mirrors the reference markdown, preserving all major sections and wording. Structure loses a point because top-level metadata fields (type, id, status, tags, confidence, visibility, source_type, source_uri, source_author, source_published, captured_at, generated_by, review_status) are entirely absent. Coverage likewise misses these metadata fields, though all substantive content—topics, claims, examples, frameworks, takeaways, quotes—is present. Faithfulness and precision are strong: quotes are verbatim, timestamps correspond exactly (e.g., 0:34→34s, 3:36→216s), and no invented claims were found. Compression is high with no redundant restatement.
